get.summary: Read verified Google visitor history, owner only
get.x-access-policy: Verified Google owner in PORTFOLIO_ENABLED mode, mapped active identity and valid device session, explicit pilot organization. Portfolio visitors and all other roles denied. No raw tokens, IP or internal hashes returned.

200.description: data contains email, display_name, account_kind, first_seen_at, last_seen_at and visit_count; meta contains limit, has_more and next_cursor. Keyset order last_seen_at descending, private no-store.
